name: WayriCAD Trace Refiner
description: Preview bounded routing-jog cleanup or center existing pad/via track contacts.
description_full: Choose separate routing-jog refinement or pad/via endpoint centering. Centering adjusts only an existing straight-track endpoint already touching one unambiguous same-net copper pad or via; the default movement bound is 0.25 mm and the allowed range is greater than zero through 2 mm. It does not bridge actual gaps or move terminals. Jog refinement supports bounded displacement and shortening, up to 2,048 segments per eligible chain, review-table focus, metrics and proposal exclusions before revalidation. Preserves protected endpoints, widths and layers; locked, grouped and uncertain routing stays unchanged. Differential-pair names and user-protected critical nets are excluded; custom length/skew/pair rules remain protected. Native connectivity and before/after KiCad DRC must pass before applying either mode. Includes source/rule staleness protection and in-window Undo/Redo. Not a router, length tuner or signal-integrity qualification tool.
